mapper.select: SELECT l.location_id AS locationId, location_name AS locationName, address, latitude, longitude, dcl.sequence, dcl.course_memo AS courseMemo FROM tb_location l JOIN tb_date_course_location dcl ON l.location_id = dcl.location_id WHERE l.location_id = #{locationId} AND dcl.course_id = #{courseId} AND l.location_status = 'UNCHANGED' AND dcl.course_location_status = true
SELECT location_id, latitude, longitude, location_name, address, location_status, created_at, updated_at FROM tb_location WHERE location_id = #{locationId} AND location_status = 'UNCHANGED'

SELECT l.location_id AS locationId, l.location_name AS locationName, l.latitude, l.longitude, COUNT(m.moment_id) AS momentCount FROM tb_location l LEFT JOIN tb_moment m ON l.location_id = m.location_id AND m.moment_status = true WHERE ROUND(l.latitude, 2) = ROUND(#{lat}, 2) AND ROUND(l.longitude, 2) = ROUND(#{lng}, 2) GROUP BY l.location_id

SELECT ROUND(latitude, #{round}) AS latitude, ROUND(longitude, #{round}) AS longitude, COUNT(*) AS count FROM tb_location WHERE location_status = 'UNCHANGED' GROUP BY ROUND(latitude, #{round}), ROUND(longitude, #{round})

SELECT l.location_id AS locationId, l.location_name AS locationName, l.latitude, l.longitude, l.address, COALESCE(SUM(m.moment_view), 0) AS viewCount, COALESCE(SUM(m.moment_like), 0) AS likeCount FROM tb_location l LEFT JOIN tb_moment m ON l.location_id = m.location_id AND m.moment_status = true WHERE l.normalized_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') AND l.location_status = 'UNCHANGED' GROUP BY l.location_id ORDER BY CASE WHEN l.normalized_name = #{keyword} THEN 0 WHEN l.normalized_name LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') THEN 1 WHEN l.normalized_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, (SUM(m.moment_view) + SUM(m.moment_like) * 5) DESC, LENGTH(l.normalized_name) ASC

SELECT l.location_id AS locationId, l.location_name AS locationName, l.latitude, l.longitude, COUNT(m.moment_id) AS momentCount FROM tb_location l LEFT JOIN tb_moment m ON m.location_id = l.location_id AND m.moment_status = true WHERE l.geohash LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%') GROUP BY l.location_id

SELECT location_id AS locationId, location_name AS locationName, latitude, longitude, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_moment m WHERE m.location_id = l.location_id AND m.moment_status = true) AS momentCount FROM tb_location l WHERE ST_Distance_Sphere(l.location_point, ST_GeomFromText(CONCAT('POINT(', #{longitude}, ' ', #{latitude}, ')'))) <= #{radiusMeters}

SELECT l.location_id AS locationId, l.location_name AS locationName, l.latitude, l.longitude, ( COALESCE(SUM(m.moment_view), 0) + COALESCE(COUNT(ml.like_id), 0) * 5 ) AS score FROM tb_location l LEFT JOIN tb_moment m ON m.location_id = l.location_id AND m.moment_status = true LEFT JOIN tb_moment_like ml ON ml.moment_id = m.moment_id WHERE ST_Distance_Sphere(l.location_point, ST_GeomFromText(CONCAT('POINT(', #{longitude}, ' ', #{latitude}, ')'))) <= #{radiusMeters} AND l.location_status = 'UNCHANGED' GROUP BY l.location_id ORDER BY score DESC, l.location_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT l.location_id AS locationId, l.location_name AS locationName, l.address, l.latitude, l.longitude, COUNT(m.moment_id) AS momentCount, COALESCE(SUM(m.moment_view), 0) AS totalView, COALESCE(SUM( (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_moment_like ml WHERE ml.moment_id = m.moment_id) ), 0) AS totalLike FROM tb_location l LEFT JOIN tb_moment m ON l.location_id = m.location_id AND m.moment_status = true WHERE l.location_id = #{locationId} GROUP BY l.location_id
